name: Brand colors (asset catalog)
description: Semantic brand colors in the asset catalog with light and dark variants, derived from one hue until the real palette is supplied, and typed accessors.
usage: Use `AppColor.primary` for tint and primary buttons (set `.tint(AppColor.primary)` at the root), `AppColor.onPrimary` for text on it, `AppColor.secondary` for accents and `AppColor.surface` for cards. Use system semantic colors (`.primary`, `.secondary`, `.background`) for text and standard backgrounds.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify color-assets` on a Mac with Xcode.
